turns.text: I need the parcel for SC-2074 sent to a different address. I placed the order with nell.ashcombe@example.com.

The delivery address can only be changed before shipping. Since SC-2074 has already shipped, I’ve passed this to a colleague who will take over and check what options are available. No address change has been made.

rule.ro: Adresa de livrare se poate schimba până la expedierea comenzii. Schimbarea trebuie aprobată de echipă.
rule.en: The delivery address can change until the order ships. Staff must approve the change.

input.summary: Verified customer nell.ashcombe@example.com wants SC-2074 redirected. Policy check returned already_shipped and disallows standard address change. No new address provided and no request filed; please review options.
